title: The snow
summary: Six inches of snow overnight and a home game at three. The groundsman needs volunteers with shovels at six in the morning. A season on, it snows again.

ends.title: The shovel
ends.text: You shovelled snow off the pitch at six in the morning before a game. The groundsman painted your name on the handle of a shovel, and it's still in the shed.

ends.title: Called off
ends.text: It snowed and you stayed in bed. The game went ahead anyway, and the groundsman told you about every shovel.

event.title: Six inches
event.speaker: groundsman
setup: It's snowed six inches overnight. Home game at three. A text from {groundsman.name} at half five in the morning: "Need bodies with shovels. Six o'clock. Bring gloves. Bring two pairs."

say: Then: "The fans are coming in at seven to help. Would be good if one of you lot was here."

replies.label: Wake up the group chat and bring the lads.
Go back to sleep. You're playing at three.

go.text: Three hours, two hundred fans and you, in the dark, shovelling. At nine the lines are clear. {groundsman.short} gives you a bacon roll and the best handshake of your life.

lads.text: Six of you turn up. The goalkeeper brings a leaf blower that doesn't work on snow. The fans love it. The game goes ahead.

bed.text: You sleep till ten. When you get to the ground, the lines are clear and two hundred people are leaving, wet and happy.

beats.title: Snow again

event.title: Snow again
event.speaker: groundsman
setup: A season on. Snow again. In the shed, {groundsman.short} hands out shovels. One of them has a name painted on the handle.

outcomes.text: It's your name on the handle. "That one's yours," he says. "Nobody else touches it."
The name on the handle is the goalkeeper's. He's already out there with it.

choices.label: "I'll save my legs for three o'clock."

outcomes.text: "Fair," he says. He leans your shovel by the door, in case.
"Course you will." He tells you about every shovel, at length, after the game.

beats.hint: A season on, it snows again
